0.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_000
0.description: Squawk! Trespassing on Ehcatl territory, featherless one is! What business have you with us!?

1.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_001
1.description: Squawk! Trespassing on Ehcatl territory, featherless one is! What business have you with us!?

4.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_A1_000_002
4.description: What kind of place is this?

6.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_010
6.description: Guard territory of Ehcatl, Razel does! Step out of line and gut you with talons, Razel will! Squawk!

7.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_011
7.description: Gathering of artisans and engineers, this is. Call ourselves “Ehcatl Nine”!

8.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_012
8.description: Drawn by dream of Chief Totoloc, we were... Hmmm. To fly again. Yes. To soar!

9.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_013
9.description: Snigger at our dreams, do you? Hmmm? Have last cackle, we will! Caw!

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_020
10.description: Shipyard of Ehcatl Nine, this is!

11.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_021
11.description: Obvious, now, what we do here, yes? Building special airship, we are!

12.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_022
12.description: Latest technology! Revolutionary ideas! Bind them together to create unique hybrid vessel, we will!

13.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_023
13.description: Privileged to be here, featherless one is! Be sneaky and stealthy, we must! Keep camp secret even from our own kin, we do!

14.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_024
14.description: Like that we borrow no-feathers technology, they would not!

15.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_025
15.description: Caw! Like that we borrow no-feathers technology, no-feathers would not either!

16.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_026
16.description: Hide from both, we do! Secret and safe! Blather about what you see here, featherless one must not!

17.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_027
17.description: Betray our trust, and mount featherless one's head on airship prow, Razel will! Squawk!

18.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_100
18.description: Squawk! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Have questions for Razel, do you? Hmmm?

21.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_A2_000_002
21.description: What do you do here again?

23.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_110
23.description: Squawk! Well! Very well, we fare!

24.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_111
24.description: Great success, first flight of <hex:021A020203>Dezul Qualan<hex:021A020103> was! Very high, it flew! Soared like bird! But satisfied, we are not...

25.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_112
25.description: Not until we land upon shores of Ayatlan! Dream yet of that day, we do!

26.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_113
26.description: And so work, we shall. Today. Tomorrow. Work until we can climb high above clouds, we will! Squawk!

27.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_200
27.description: Squawk! Well! Very well, we fare!

28.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_201
28.description: Great success, first flight of <hex:021A020203>Dezul Qualan<hex:021A020103> was! Very high, it flew! Soared like bird! But satisfied, we are not...

29.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_202
29.description: Not until we land upon shores of Ayatlan! Dream yet of that day, we do!

30.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_203
30.description: Hmmm? Making solemn face, featherless one is. Strikes awe into heart, name of Ayatlan does? Yes? Then take you there, perhaps we will!

31.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_204
31.description: But now work, we must. Today. Tomorrow. Work until we can climb high above clouds, we will! Squawk!

32.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_120
32.description: Fall from airship and bump head, did you? Ehcatl, this is! Shipyard of Ehcatl Nine!

33.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_121
33.description: Still seek to improve airship, we do!

34.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_122
34.description: Ixal technology, no-feathers technology─it matters not. Only dream of flying.

35.name: TEXT_REGFSTEHCATL_00203_RAZELHUIZAN_000_123
35.description: Kept Ehcatl secret, you have? Yes? Feel sad about gutting <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, Razel would.
